phisher_phelix.name: Phisher Phelix
phisher_phelix.intro: Don't touch the rig! It's almost mined a whole coin! ...A tenth of a coin!
phisher_phelix.after: Fine. Unplug it. It cost us more than it made anyway.

phisher_phanie.name: Phisher Phanie
phisher_phanie.intro: Hi! I'm from the power company. Please read me your account number.
phisher_phanie.after: Ransom pays in crypto. Mined right here. Ironic.

lineman_leo.name: Lineman Leo
lineman_leo.intro: I climb poles for a living. You're not even a challenge!
lineman_leo.after: Rolf's the only one who knows where every wire goes. He wrote it all down.

electrician_ella.name: Electrician Ella
electrician_ella.intro: Watch your step. Some of these wires are live. So am I!

hvac_hank.name: HVAC Hank
hvac_hank.intro: Let's turn the heat up. Then down. Then up. HVAC humor.
hvac_hank.after: The miner had the server room at 40 degrees. Rolf nearly cried.

rolf_brandt.name: Department Head Rolf
rolf_brandt.intro: Rolf Brandt, Facilities. Forty years keeping the lights on. Someone stole power from MY plant. Show me you can take the load.
rolf_brandt.defeat: Steady current. You've earned the Facilities Cert.
rolf_brandt.after: Uptimus sleeps under this plant, they say. Maybe someday you'll meet it.

vacation_val.name: Sysadmin Val
vacation_val.intro: I'm on vacation. Which means I only check my email every 4 minutes. Battle!
vacation_val.after: There's no signal up top. Bliss.

phisher_phoenix.name: Phisher Phoenix
phisher_phoenix.intro: Off-site backup? More like off-site... gone. Nobody gets past me.
phisher_phoenix.after: Cron's up there. He never looks happy.

pen_tester_petra.name: Pen Tester Petra
pen_tester_petra.intro: I break into things for a living. Legally! Let's test your defenses.
pen_tester_petra.after: Kalb hired me to break in here. I'm still trying.

blue_team_bo.name: Blue Team Bo
blue_team_bo.intro: Red team breaks in. Blue team holds the line. Guess which one I am.
blue_team_bo.after: Kalb's Crabinet has never once been breached.

major_kalb.name: Major Kalb
major_kalb.intro: Major Vesna Kalb, SecOps. You passed my phishing test and my team. Now pass me.
major_kalb.defeat: ...Verified. You've earned the Security Cert. And maybe a little trust.
major_kalb.after: Talk to me. I have something for you.
